sn55.48:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme. atha kho bhaddiyo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe…
sn55.48:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho bhaddiyaṃ sakkaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn55.48:1.3: catūhi kho bhaddiya, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.48:2.2: idha bhaddiya, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.48:2.5: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.48:2.6: imehi kho bhaddiya, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
